context_requirements: MET receptor expression and/or activation (HGF autocrine/paracrine or MET amplification)
Addiction to MET-driven survival/proliferation signaling for a strong antiproliferative response
Intact downstream apoptotic machinery for cell-death-related transcriptional changes
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression at 24 h in any of the nine lines
No induction of apoptosis or stress-response genes at 24 h in any line
Strong and consistent transcriptional response in all nine lines regardless of MET expression status
Clear transcriptional response at 6 h that is not sustained or amplified at 24 h

evidence.supports: ARQ 197 is a selective c-MET inhibitor with target inhibition demonstrated in patients
cabozantinib inhibits c-Met, reduces viability and spheroid formation, and induces apoptosis in pancreatic cancer cells
PHA665752 selectively inhibits c-MET, induces apoptosis and cell-cycle arrest in TPR-MET-transformed cells
SU11274 c-Met inhibitor induces autophagy and cell death in A549 lung cancer cells
c-Met inhibitors suppress growth of c-Met-overexpressing gastric cancer cells by inducing G1/S arrest
